from PyQt5.QtWidgets import *
from PyQt5.uic import loadUi
def calculV(Uact,Upre):
    return Uact/Upre
def calcul():
        
    eps=float(w.precision.text())
    u0=1
    u1=1
    v0=1

    w.table.setRowCount(0)  # vider le QTableWidget
    w.table.insertRow(0)
    w.table.setItem(0,0,QTableWidgetItem("0"))
    w.table.setItem(0,1,QTableWidgetItem(str(u0)))
    w.table.setItem(0,2,QTableWidgetItem(str(v0)))
    w.table.insertRow(1)
    w.table.setItem(1,0,QTableWidgetItem("1"))
    w.table.setItem(1,1,QTableWidgetItem(str(u1)))
    v1=calculV(u1,u0)
    w.table.setItem(1,2,QTableWidgetItem(str(v1)))
    arret=False
    i=2
    while not arret:
        u=u0+u1
        v=calculV(u,u1)
        u0=u1
        u1=u
        
        w.table.insertRow(i)
        w.table.setItem(i,0,QTableWidgetItem(str(i)))
        w.table.setItem(i,1,QTableWidgetItem(str(u)))
        w.table.setItem(i,2,QTableWidgetItem(str(v)))
        arret=abs(v-v1)<eps
        v1=v
        i=i+1
    

###############  PP  ###########
app=QApplication([])
w=loadUi("interface.ui")
w.btnCalculer.clicked.connect(calcul)

w.show()
app.exec_()
